arStrings.szText:
Your maximum number of {c_important}Skeleton Mages{/c} is increased by {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} and they are upgraded to Arch-Mages.

Arch-Mages teleport to safety when attacked and their attacks occasionally shatter on impact, dealing {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage to the enemy and up to {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} additional targets.
